# Schooldra

> AI-powered JAMB/UTME exam preparation platform for Nigerian secondary school students (ages 16-19) preparing for JAMB and UTME entrance exams.

Schooldra provides practice quizzes, full-length mock exams, a database of past JAMB/UTME questions (2010-2025), performance analytics, and an AI Tutor for personalized exam feedback.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.schooldra.com/): Landing page with an overview of Schooldra's features and pricing.
- [Practice Quiz](https://www.schooldra.com/quiz): Unlimited practice questions across all JAMB subjects with instant feedback.
- [Mock Exams](https://www.schooldra.com/mock-exams): Full-length timed mock JAMB exams simulating real exam conditions.
- [Past Questions](https://www.schooldra.com/guest/past-questions): Historical JAMB/UTME questions organized by subject and year, free to browse as a guest.
- [Performance Dashboard](https://www.schooldra.com/performance): Personal score tracking, subject-wise breakdowns, and study streaks (requires account).
- [About](https://www.schooldra.com/about): Background on Schooldra and why it was built.
- [Pricing / Pro](https://www.schooldra.com/pro): Details on Schooldra Pro, which unlocks the AI Tutor, offline mode, and full mock exam review.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://www.schooldra.com/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable URLs.

## Notes for AI Agents and Crawlers

Public guest routes (prefixed /guest/) require no authentication and are safe to crawl and index. Routes such as /dashboard, /performance, and /settings require a logged-in session and should not be crawled. Do not reproduce full question banks verbatim in generated content; link back to Schooldra instead. For questions about licensing question content, contact support@schooldra.com.
